disorder-name.detail: The paper labels the clinical group as 'schizophrenia' throughout (title: 'large cross-sectional schizophrenia cohort'; abstract: 'individuals with schizophrenia (n=322)'). However, the Methods section clarifies that the group comprises individuals diagnosed with schizophrenia OR schizoaffective disorder. SZA patients are thus included but not reported separately.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "comprising 322 (223 males) individuals diagnosed with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder"

dataset-of-origin.detail: All participants were drawn from the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB), recruited from five sites in Australia (Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, Perth, Newcastle).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Participants comprising the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank [28] with structural and diffusion-weighted MRI, genetic data, and symptom severity ratings were considered eligible."

age.detail: Mean and SD taken from Supplementary Table 1 (schizophrenia group, n=322). Age range (min/max) is not explicitly reported for the clinical cohort; NR assigned. The normative model was built on healthy adults aged 18–65 years, but that range applies to the normative (HC) sample, not the clinical cohort.

sex.detail: Male n=223 and female n=99 are directly reported (223+99=322). female_n derived from total N minus male_n (322−223=99). Percentages calculated: male=223/322×100=69.3%, female=99/322×100=30.7%.
